client_implementation.description: Client implementation type. Valid values are "embedded" (use embedded client) or "cli" (use CLI binaries, default).

client_secret.description: Client Secret (env: `BW_CLIENTSECRET`). Do not commit this information in Git unless you know what you're doing. Prefer using a Terraform `variable {}` in order to inject this value from the environment.

extra_ca_certs.description: Extends the well known 'root' CAs (like VeriSign) with the extra certificates in file (env: `NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS`, doesn't work with embedded client).

master_password.description: Master password of the Vault (env: `BW_PASSWORD`). Do not commit this information in Git unless you know what you're doing. Prefer using a Terraform `variable {}` in order to inject this value from the environment.

vault_path.description: Alternative directory for storing the Vault locally (default: `.bitwarden/`, env: `BITWARDENCLI_APPDATA_DIR`; set to empty string to use CLI default).

disable_sync_after_write_verification.description: Skip verification of server-side modifications (like timestamp updates) after write operations - useful when the Bitwarden server makes minor, non-functional changes to objects.

embedded_client.description: Use the embedded client instead of an external binary.

file.description: Path to the content of the attachment.

file_name.description: File name. Required if specifying `content` in a resource.

item_id.description: Identifier of the item the attachment belongs to

collection_ids.description: Identifier of the collections the item belongs to.

favorite.description: Mark as a Favorite to have item appear at the top of your Vault in the UI.

reprompt.description: Require master password 're-prompt' when displaying secret in the UI.

revision_date.description: Last time the item was updated.
